name: Strand Golf Club
notes: Card data from Strand's scorecard photos (IMG_1572), read on 28 Oct 2026: par, stroke index, metres per hole for Yellow, White and Red, and each tee's men's and ladies' Course Rating / Slope.
The card has one par and stroke index row, used for men and ladies.
The card has no separate front-nine or back-nine ratings, so only 18-hole rounds can be scored. Add them here if the club supplies them.
The card prints the White total as 5606; its nines (2637 + 2968) make 5605. Per-hole lengths are used as printed.
Card note: plus handicaps give back strokes on holes 4, 15, 8, 12, then 3, the same as stroke index 18, 17, 16, 15, 14.
Yellow tees on holes 3, 14: the map's tee box is more than 15 m off the card length, so the tee is placed from the card length.
White tees on holes 5, 12, 16: the map's tee box is more than 15 m off the card length, so the tee is placed from the card length.
Red tees on holes 5, 8, 12, 17: the map's tee box is more than 15 m off the card length, so the tee is placed from the card length.
